purpose: Regular-season totals and rates of every player in the researched All-Star Games and Rookie Challenges (library/all_star/games), for the season each game belongs to: the anchors of the exhibition translation (scripts/build_all_star_engine.py). The real Dwyane Wade is excluded.
units: totals as published; usage, assist, rebound, steal and block rates as fractions (the engine's rate form)

sources.provider: Basketball-Reference, via the sumitrodatta/nba-alt-awards GitHub copy
sources.notes: a traded player's combined row (2TM, 3TM) is used
